notes.title: AFTER HE ESCAPED - Update 2.0
notes.content:
Leaving the warehouse behind, AFTER HE ESCAPED brings a new experience set in the museum itself. [b]A classic horror-adventure journey[/b] that will have the player explore the large rooms and halls of the museum to solve puzzles, find and use items and overcome the varied challenges that the now decayed museum has in store for its visitors.

Unlike the previous modes, this is not a roguelike mode, it is essentially an entire new handcrafted game and [b]the biggest update yet for HE ESCAPED.[/b]

I don't want to spoil what awaits inside the walls of the museum, so I'll leave the player to discover it and just say thank you to everyone who has supported my game so far, and thank you to any and all new players too. I hope everyone enjoys this new adventure and see it through the end.

Good luck!

notes.title: HE ESCAPED Update 1.5
notes.content:
Hi there, the new update 1.5 for HE ESCAPED is here and it comes with the following additions and changes:

[b]New game mode: [i]VEL-LA[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44673102/20ab1442f45bdd636df659678fbf72614568c266.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Uncover the candle carefully and pick up the key if you think you are alone in the room. But be careful, uncovering the candle for too long will attract the danger if it's hiding in the room. Check the room before the timer runs out and risk picking up the key or be safe and forfeit your turn. 
The new game mode is playable alone and in local multiplayer for up to 4 players.
[/list]

[b][i]WHERE IS THE KEY?[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] The color of the jars is brighter to make them easier to see in the dark.
[*] The jars are slightly bigger in size.
[/list]

[b]Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new achievement for escaping the [i]VEL-LA[/i] mode in maximum danger.
[*] Added a new achievement for escaping the [i]HE ESCAPED[/i] mode with no sound.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the starting lights sound to play improperly when restarting a session of [i]HE ESCAPED[/i].
[*] Fixed an issue when opening doors that sometimes caused minor animation issues in [i]HE ESCAPED[/i].
[*] Added new icons to the main menu for each different game mode.
[/list]

notes.title: HE ESCAPED Update 1
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who has supported HE ESCAPED on its first weekend out. Here are the patch notes of the first update.

[b][i]HE ESCAPED[/i][/b]

[list]
[*] New items can be found throughout the rooms. 
[*] Danger can now appear in new places.
[*] Keys can now appear in new places.
[/list]
[b][i]WHERE ARE THE KEYS?[/i][/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new DANGER option with 4 different difficulties.
[*] Adjusted the size of the jars to make them easier to see.
[*] This mode can now be played in local multiplayer.
[/list]
[b]Achievements[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new achievement for beating the [i]WHERE ARE THE KEYS?[/i] mode in maximum danger setting.
[/list]
[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that made a prompt text appear in the incorrect language.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/list]
If you notice any major issues please report them so that I can fix the bugs that I might've missed.
Thank you very much for your support.
